generated_by: turn-reduction:work-board init/adopt from templates/authorization.json. Trim the granted list to what is true for this project; tighten freely, loosen only on Graham's per-project ruling (G4).

tiers.just_do_it: commit; push the session's own commits through the push procedure; move cards. Logged, never asked.
tiers.reviewer_agent: merges, staging deploys, runbooks before they run: done after a higher-tier reviewer agent gives a green verdict, recorded on the card. A project whose spec or ADR requires Graham's review for merges keeps that until its own doc is amended.
tiers.graham_via_inbox: prod deploys, prod or cloud writes outside staging, credentials, deletes, anything that changes project intent, anything on the global never-pre-authorizable list other than the push carve-out. Asked as an inbox card on the work board, never in chat.

push_procedure.applies_to: a session's own commits, to a repo whose origin is under github.com/GFMCloud/. Other sessions' commits, force pushes and anything under gmorris1221 stay stop-listed.
steps: Record the SHA of every commit this session creates.

Run push_check.sh --repo <repo> --branch <branch> [--base <ref>] --sha <each recorded SHA>. It checks: the active gh account is GFMCloud; origin is under github.com/GFMCloud/; gitleaks finds nothing; git log --oneline <base>..HEAD lists exactly the recorded SHAs, where the base is origin/<branch>, or on a branch's first push origin's default branch (pass --base origin/<branch> for a branch stacked on another; --base takes only a ref under refs/remotes/origin/, never a SHA, HEAD~N or local branch). Any mismatch is a hard stop.
Push as a separate command, never chained to the check.
Code: push a branch first and wait for CI green where the repo has CI. Docs-only commits may go direct with no CI, stated on the card.

pushes_per_session.unit: pushes of the session's own commits in one session
